title: NO HOLES! Terrible, how am I supposed to use it???
text: NO HOLES! Terrible, how am I supposed to use it???. This is just what I wanted but the one I got had NO HOLES AT ALL. The hole punch was kind of there but not really it wasn't even pierced at all, only a very slight shape where it was supposed to be but NO HOLE! I cannot use this at all, if it had the hole in it I would have rated this a 5 out of 5 but since there is no hole and it is not very likely I can make it myself, I give this 2 stars... DON'T BUY IT!
